title: worker-results.jsonl row (one check result)
description: One row per check result under .dabbler/runs/<set>/s<N>/critique/<change-id>/worker-results.jsonl, appended only by router commands after validation. Every quote carries a path, a span, and a content hash that the framework — not the worker — verifies against the reviewed tree. An absence claim is not evidence that a search happened: the worker declares the query and the closed scope, and the framework reruns it and records what it found. A blocked result is a real outcome, not a soft failure; nothing in this schema lets a worker that ran out of context or tools present blocked work as a pass.

schema_version.description: Frozen at v1. A reader that finds any other value refuses the row rather than interpreting it.

blocked_reason.description: Required when result is blocked. Naming the reason is what makes a blocked result reviewable instead of a shrug.

quotes.description: Positive evidence. The framework verifies each hash against the reviewed tree and refuses the row on mismatch.

ast_kind.description: Where a supported parser exists, the node kind at that location, so a string literal containing code-like text cannot satisfy a call-site contract.

absence_searches.description: Negative evidence, re-executed by the framework. The worker supplies query and scope; tool_version and result are recorded by the framework.

severity.description: The existing vocabulary. This pipeline does not fork it.
